Thanks Monica — hi Rajiv, Dylan. I’ll own the CSM side and coordinate the MAP + runbook. First pass below; want to validate details on our sync tomorrow.

High-level approach (proposal):
1) Phased backfill: incremental windowed backfill to limit peak load (day1: seed 10%, day2: +30%, day3: +60%, day4: full)
2) Vector store decision: keep current vendor for immediate cutover while we run a parallel ingest to Redwood-managed store for fallback testing (reduces risk)
3) Rerank evals: we’ll run a 5k-query eval set (sample attached rerank-eval-sample.jsonl) and measure MRR@10 and NDCG@10; aim for >= 15% relative improvement over baseline retrieval
4) Monitoring & rollback: redwood console dashboards + automatic fallback to prior retrieval model if latency or MRR degrade >5%

Questions for Rajiv: can you confirm S3 path for full corpus export and whether doc ids are stable across exports? Also confirm their acceptable maintenance window and whether they can support a brief read-only snapshot during backfill.

Proposed next steps (owners & ETA):
- Laura: create MAP and runbook draft (ETA 2026-10-08)
- Dylan: sizing + backfill throughput estimate + test plan (ETA 2026-10-07)
- Monica: procurement/contract check and access to S3 (ETA 2026-10-06)

Quick technical assessment based on sample and counts:
- Corpus 7M docs, avg 450 tokens -> embedding size 1536 implies storage ~7M * 1536 * 4 bytes ~43GB raw (float32). With PQ (quantization) we can reduce active RAM footprint significantly.
- Backfill options:
  * Option A (fast): Bulk ingest to Redwood-managed vector store using batched GPU transforms; expect ~50k docs/hr on current staging (one p4-like node). Full backfill ~140 hours; with parallelism (3 nodes) ~46 hours.
  * Option B (low-risk): Keep Pinecone live, run parallel ingest into Redwood; switch traffic when parity is reached. Requires cross-index checks and alignment on id mapping.
- Indexing strategy: recommend IVFPQ with HNSW re-ranking index for nearest-neighbor at query time (hybrid retrieval). That keeps recall high and reranker cheap.
- Downtime plan: incremental backfill + final sync window (we can do a ~3 hour read-only snapshot for final delta apply).

I need a sample of the S3 export (10k docs) with real metadata fields and canonical ids to validate sharding strategy — can Rajiv share a pre-signed URL?

Dylan Brooks
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
